brief:
Israeli forces entered the village of al-Rafid in southern Quneitra countryside and conducted raids on multiple residences, local sources in the province said, according to Shehab Wire. The incursion marks the latest reported Israeli military operation in the area.

Search operations inside al-Rafid were described by the sources as extensive, though no immediate details emerged about the purpose of the raids or their duration. Quneitra province, located in southwestern Syria near the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights, has witnessed repeated cross-border military activity in recent years.
